title: Manual Resolve
description: manual-resolve/v1 — a party asking to discharge the report's obligation without any collateral moving, because it was settled between the parties outside the platform or the call no longer stands. Either party may ask; the counterparty answers, and the request is already the requester's own consent. Nothing closes until it is accepted, and a refusal ends nothing — the exceptions stay open, so the requester may ask again with new grounds or post after all. The exceptions it answers are the ones the event CITES in its reference list, and are not repeated here: a second naming could only disagree with the first.

manualResolveId.description: Identity of this request, minted by the facade and handed to clients, who answer it by id through the collateral API. On the log the answer names it by citing this event.

reportId.description: The report whose obligation would be discharged.

reason.description: Why closing without collateral is appropriate — not a restatement of why the leg failed, which the exception already carries.
